focus.title: Turn early wins into prizes
focus.action: After an early won skirmish, take the river, a camp or the nearest tower before backing; and with the support dead, push no deeper than the last structure taken until all five are up.

14.2.call: Duo-lane and offlane kills were two separate plays, then Mini Prime went allied. Split pressure ending at the pit is the right call.

20.2.call: Opened four against five with Narbash dead, after Bayle razed the offlane inner tower. Skylar and Lt. Belica had open lanes then: call that rotation before fighting a body down.

21.8.call: Won five to one on mid; the mid inner fell mid-fight and the inhibitor after. With all five up and the mid outer down, force this fight.

26.8.call: Steel killed Skylar then Narbash, yet the duo-lane fight went three to two; two inhibitors and Primal Fangtooth followed. Narbash peels for the carry against Steel.

6b8c70e6-95cf-4b07-b7cc-bfb7e88ad4f3: Killed Steel four times, and both offlane towers fell within a minute of a Steel kill. Whenever Steel is dead, hit the next offlane structure before backing.
All three deaths went to Steel, two outside any detected fight early. Bull Rush is unstoppable: hold crowd control until the charge ends, and trade once Shield Slam is down.
8f50ef0b-39f0-4fac-845f-b7de168ce90c: 10.2 CS per minute against a 6.2 norm, with three Steel kills, all on the offlane. Hold that clear rate whenever no objective is up.
Died to Muriel at the Fangtooth pit, outside any detected fight, right after the enemy took Fangtooth. Once the enemy holds Fangtooth, leave the pit and take a camp instead.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: 20668 healing, the most of all ten players, plus 12 wards on an 8.9 norm and no deaths in the first ten minutes. Hold that ward pace before every Fangtooth.
Scored the first kill of the mid teamfight, on Sparrow, and the fight went five to one. Once the duo outer falls, join mid fights with the carry.
Died to Sparrow on the enemy duo lane; the next fight opened four against five. With Sparrow unseen, ward the enemy duo lane before walking up.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Six kills, three on Kaelen, and a Muriel and Sparrow pair of kills right before razing the duo outer tower. Keep hitting the tower after every duo-lane kill.

Both deaths went to Steel, the second opening the final fight on the duo lane. Against Steel, walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into the wall.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Five rotation kills on the duo lane, each followed by an allied prize, starting with Mini Prime. Repeat the trip whenever a duo fight starts and mid is quiet.
Kills on Muriel, Steel and Morigesh won the final fight after Skylar and Narbash fell first. Damn clean. When allies drop first, finish the cleanup once enemy stuns are spent.

eternal: Knell shreds both armors on hero hits and keeps a share; Frequency adds attack speed and haste per Rust stack.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
ourKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
ourKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
ourKits.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
ourKits.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

ourKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
ourKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
ourKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
ourKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
ourKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
enemyKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
enemyKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Throw Alacrity for a shield and speed, place Consecrated Ground for ally attack speed and healing, fully charge Serenity for a stun, and use Reversal of Fortune to fly to an ally anywhere and knock up enemies on arrival.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep the carry alive with shields and Reversal of Fortune saves while Sentinel cuts enemy healing.
enemyKits.passive: Sentinel: her damaging abilities cut enemy healing and her abilities boost allies' healing and shielding received.
enemyKits.playWith: A hyper-carry she can shield and a team that can follow her global ult into a fight.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the charging Serenity bolt and step out of its line before it reaches max charge. When Reversal of Fortune is down she cannot join distant fights, so pick off her side lanes then.

bullets: Flux Matrix makes nearby enemy heroes take 10% more magical damage, which every Steel ability deals, and halves nearby enemy tenacity, so stuns last longer on tenacity builds.
Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies every second and ramps up to 40% more damage while the burn stays on one target, so Steel wants to stick close after engaging.
When an enemy basic-attacked Steel, Tainted Guard cut that attacker's healing 45% for 3s and added a bleed; 23 ability haste cut Shield Slam's cooldown to about 77.2s.
Dire Howl grants Omnivamp for 5s, then heals Bayle for part of the damage taken in that window; Draconum stacks add 2% increased healing each, up to 10.
Earthshaker stacks twice as fast for melee heroes, so Vigil swings and Cursed Edge slashes on heroes quickly built up to 10 stacks of 1.25% more ability damage.
65 ability haste from all four items cut Kingslayer from 115s to about 69.7s, while Mistmeadow Buckler spent Mistwood Guard charges to block part of incoming magical damage.
Holding the blade, Light of the Heavens shields Kwang for 2.5s; ability hits Energize the blade, giving Kwang 45% attack speed for more Prophecy on-hit damage.
Magical hits like Judgement of the Heavens applied Tainted Scepter, cutting the target's healing by 45% for 4s; takedowns refilled all 15 Malice stacks for bonus ability damage.
Spirit Of Amir made abilities deal 12% more damage to monsters for faster clears, and 35 ability haste cut Fury of the Heavens from 85s to about 63s.
Combustion's area blast and Noxia's 6% maximum health hit both run on cooldowns, and Noxia fires only when a second ability lands on a hero the first marked.
An ability hit on a hero near Void Drone also triggers a drone zap, so Void Bomb and Seismic Assault hits stacked drone damage with the item effects.
Against heroes below 40% health, Wraith Leggings added 12% magical damage to abilities, and max-rank Neural Disruptor resets when the enemy hero is taken down shortly after.

coachLean.headline: We cashed won fights into structures: ten towers to none, and every major objective after their lone Fangtooth was ours.

flags.text: Converted 5 of 8 won fights into a prize within 90 seconds, including Mini Prime and Fangtooth.

Drafted no tank into their two; our teamfight plan from the kits opens with Narbash Thunk.
